pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and sub-ovoid dark regions with jagged, high-frequency edge jitter; pixel gradients at borders are soft to medium; patches on the upper flank occupy a greater relative spatial area compared to the smaller, more fragmented patches on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin light-colored interstitial pathways; junction nodes are primarily tri-radial; corridor pixel thickness is consistently narrow, maintaining continuity across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the upper neck and dorsal ridge; the mane edge is visible as a softened, serrated contour against the background.
